messages:
Julia - Support: Hey team — customer reports persistent P50 spikes on text-generation endpoint since ~2026-03-10 14:00 UTC. They attached 3 request IDs and a short curl but need a proper repro pack. Can we gather logs + debug bundle and a small promptset to repro under load?

AlexM: Thanks — pls drop the full request IDs, model + region, and the exact sample prompt set (incl. token counts). If they have a curl that reproduces the slow case we can start there.

Julia - Support: Request IDs: r-20260310-01, r-20260310-08, r-20260310-33. Model: redwood-v1-large (quantized), region: us-west-2. Sample prompt (one of many):

"How do I optimize inference pipelines for multimodal inputs?"

Avg prompt tokens: ~42, avg generated tokens: ~280 (customer estimate). They reported single-request P50 ~420ms normally, spiking to ~1.4s intermittently.

Mike (SRE): That token split is useful. Two quick asks: 1) do they hit a consistent concurrency (RPS) or bursts? 2) can they run a curl that includes `x-request-id` and `x-trace-id` headers so we can link traces?

Julia - Support: They say bursts during batch job windows — concurrency spikes to ~80-120 concurrent requests for ~2-4 minutes. I asked them to re-run the failing request with headers. They sent back this minimal curl: 

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-large","input":"How do I optimize inference pipelines for multimodal inputs?","max_tokens":300}'
```

AlexM: Good. Ask them to add `x-request-id` and `x-trace-id` in the curl so we can fetch traces from the ingest pipeline. Example header: `-H "x-request-id: r-20260310-01" -H "x-trace-id: trace-9a1b"`. Also tell them to include `?debug=true` in the query to trigger extended debug metadata for a single request if their plan allows.

repro-bot: Automated: debug-bundle checklist created (id: dbg-1768802468). Steps: collect service logs (+30m window around request), export traces (jaeger), gather kernel metrics (GPU), and export request bodies.

Sara P: For the latency repro pack I suggest:
- Promptset: 20 prompts covering short/long prompts, include 5 with long context (>=600 tokens).
- Concurrency sweep: [1, 8, 32, 64, 128] sustained for 120s each.
- Token targets: avg output tokens 50, 200, 300.
- Model variants: redwood-v1-large (fp16/quantized) and redwood-v1-medium.

This will help isolate whether batching/kv-cache behavior at higher sequence lengths is causing spikes.

Mike (SRE): Also collect GPU kernel stalls and CUDA memstats during the windows. If customer can run `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,sm,used_memory --format=csv -l 2` on their dedicated infra, that helps. On our side we'll pull host metrics around the trace IDs once they add them.

Julia - Support: Customer replied with one enhanced curl including IDs and debug flag: 

```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?debug=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: r-20260310-33" \
  -H "x-trace-id: trace-9a1b" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-large","input":"How do I optimize inference pipelines for multimodal inputs?","max_tokens":300}'
```

AlexM: Perfect. Julia — can you run the internal debug bundle collector command for that trace once we ingest the request? Use: `rdb-debug collect --trace trace-9a1b --span-window 180 --out dbg-r20260310-33.tar.gz` and attach the bundle here. That will package logs, traces, and ingress/egress headers.

deploy-bot: Automated: debug collection requested by AlexM for trace-9a1b. ETA: ~2m.

Julia - Support: I kicked the collection, attaching partial logs below (sanitized):

[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] ingress: req=r-20260310-33 model=redwood-v1-large seq_len=342 total_tokens=382 latency_ms=1380 path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] serving: selected_kernel=flash_attn_v2 batch_size=12 kv_cache_hit=false queue_wait_ms=230 exec_ms=1020
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] egress: resp_size_bytes=12k status=200 x-request-id=r-20260310-33 x-trace-id=trace-9a1b

Mike (SRE): Those logs show a large exec_ms vs queue_wait. Exec=1020ms on a batch_size=12 suggests a perf anomaly in the kernel path for this seq_len. Next steps: 1) run localized microbench for seq_len=340 on redwood-v1-large quantized kernel to compare. 2) reproduce with concurrency 32 and 64 to see if batch composition is causing long tails.

Sara P: I'll spin up a synthetic load run on staging with the promptset and the concurrency sweep I described. If we can reproduce p50 spikes we can try toggling `batch.max_tokens` and `kv_prefill` settings to measure impact.

Julia - Support: Customer will also send a short promptset (20 prompts) and confirm whether they're using a shared Dedicated pool or Hosted. I'll post the bundle once `rdb-debug` completes.

AlexM: Great. Assigning owners: Mike -> microbench + kernel traces. Sara -> staging repro runs and promptset orchestration. Julia -> collect bundle + customer coordination. I'll follow up in 24h or earlier with findings. :thumbsup:

Julia - Support: Bundle uploaded: dbg-r20260310-33.tar.gz (link redacted). Closing loop with customer and will update thread when staging runs complete. Thanks!
